content.text: The `agents` package accepts `ai` versions `^6.0.0 || ^7.0.0` as a peer dependency, so any 6.x or 7.x release works (`node_modules/agents/package.json:84`). The peer dependency is optional (`peerDependenciesMeta`, line 122), which means you only need `ai` installed if you use the parts of `agents` that rely on it. The package itself is developed against `ai` `^7.0.0`, which is the version listed in its devDependencies.
